text:
Crazy old Carnival
sold his mattress
to buy bread and wine,
spaghetti and sausage.

Like a glutton he ate
a mountain of fried cakes;
his belly grew so big
it looked like a balance scale.
He drank and drank, and his face
turned red.
His belly burst;
he ate, ate, and would not stop.

Shrove Tuesday ends Carnival,
and they hold his funeral,
for from dust he was born
and to dust he will return.

translation.title: Crazy Old Carnival
